objects.name: Analytic 2155
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux service processes initiating outbound application-layer protocol connections to ports/destinations outside the approved communication matrix. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): connect syscall from an ICS service/application process to a destination outside the approved network or vendor-service baseline
